notes.title: Two Weeks Post-Launch: Update from Cannibal Team
notes.content:
Hello Cannibal lovers,

Today marks two weeks since the release of our game.

As expected, purchases have significantly decreased compared to the first week. As you can see from the graph, the curve is declining after the initial peak and has stabilized at about ten copies a day. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/686b9f23663992d32fcdbff0cb22352c8069713c.png[/img]

This trend aligns with our expectations based on the game's wishlist numbers. Unfortunately, this is not enough for us to quickly recoup the expenses incurred during development.

The number of new daily wishlists is good, and the wishlist conversion rate is also not bad.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/71d22525869929f68060f94236c19d4d8d71b793.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/ffe733fcee28bac34172669e11efea002f0d4b57.png[/img]

We have received excellent reviews, both in terms of quantity and quality, with almost all being positive except for just two negative reviews.

Most of our players are still from the United States, likely due to the lack of a localization system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/462cab15dc1a724894a5a0213f9b508970beab34.png[/img]

In the meantime, we have created new screenshots for the Steam page. Feedback is welcome.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/426dd4e494b83f4cac4aa6dec4b156221a630809.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/a83d90fcbd5275531d7ed9b10100c829e1fdf7ff.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/37ed88a9f2f53e340fd70b245f3169ac4268d787.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/17cc5962ec55e0ecff801a65d13c551b2721a501.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/df7d3b7116c9e65529efa5ea179ea450807aa068.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/c0c9591228bbe8ee38c9844dd9135835cda722bb.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/65eb4e49d987d2c18f17f023647e1a98c0038b26.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/fc2c215f9803ac6ddfeeb4cc0aa68ab2cf5db9bc.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/67a86c13c4dfd0ccfa5b14dc5585aabe6b3d9b37.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/8800f065311562028051ed2fd44c667f0a6ef8b6.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/d38b53443a47fe632d8be1eed8739c55e02f4a3a.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/760742f7bbbfe71cb59b23b61bcb4adf52bd5051.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/fb21ee6f688cb5cad046a507a05d67516e42b462.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/6d61d7ccbb0ed96971388016eb678d9100772c3e.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/41261ec8bf1acfef5b69d1d75ee2012220777055.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/d992159e556db5a6a934a95ea6057ce0434e0477.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/5c568101cb7fd0fb543714cdc794eacbf02d5072.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/9586880c73d4e8ff9f62947b7cbb0476a50f1991.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/667bba59da875dcfa5ac9d22cd5bdc854a3c738e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/e2b7571a42c75048d1ebbfba2e501737455026ec.jpg[/img][/url]

Last week, we were approached by a publisher interested in the game, but it turned out to be a waste of time. We plan to release a detailed postmortem of the project, where we will address the issue of publishers (always be cautious!) and some of the challenges we faced, which currently put the next episodes in doubt.

That’s all for this week.

We’ll update you soon.

Best regards from your trusty neighborhood Cannibal Team.

notes.title: Cannibal Update: Stabilizing Sales and Curator Caution
notes.content:
Hello Cannibal Lovers,

Today marks the seventh day since the release of our game, and by tomorrow, our first week will be complete.

A quick update on the numbers:
Conversions have declined compared to the first day, which was anticipated, but they are now stabilizing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/17e72983f2996c25425c28e955c61c1139bcd719.png[/img]

Wishlists continue to grow, though the increase rate has slowed since the peak on release day. We've gained an additional 1k wishlists in nearly a week. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/8b0a2d6be4628cb1937294acfd4beff7fc528c4d.png[/img]

Currently, 60% of sales have resulted from converting a wishlist into a purchase.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/8b3d7c6e3438007954e028cf2fc66697621591ac.png[/img]

Tomorrow, we will release the first update, which includes adding video settings to the options menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/c20490602a863fd2e884efd77b00e20ca6a7ec2f.png[/img]

Soon after, we'll introduce the localization system, adding Italian and Russian as the first languages.

Recently, we've been receiving numerous emails requesting promotional codes from Steam curators. Interestingly, many request these via email and advise against using Steam's internal key distribution system within the curator section, which we suspect could be scams. Therefore, we have not responded to these emails. We have only sent promotional codes using Steam’s internal system to curators who have requested to review the game through this official channel.

That’s all for today.
Have a great evening from your trusty neighborhood Cannibal Team.

notes.title: Day 4 Update for Cannibal Lovers
notes.content:
Good morning, Cannibal Lovers,
Day four post-release: here's a quick update.

The game's numbers continue to hold steady. The conversions on the third day have slightly increased compared to the second day, while the wishlists have halved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/511768203a4fb9a155f404b1d8eb4b3fc8814d66.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/461cc814d5f6da52c76e2ba33c88e2983aab0d47.png[/img]

The primary audience remains the American players, largely because the game is currently available only in English. We hope that localizing the game will help us reach a broader audience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/dfd83820b087f90db2f63f56428a8802eb107b07.png[/img]

Regarding achievements, no player has unlocked "Coercion" or "Empathy" yet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/c83d8056b05713157d2aed1a362e22242a93582b.png[/img]

That’s all for today.
See you tomorrow!

notes.title: The day after
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

First and foremost, we extend our heartfelt thanks to all who supported us by purchasing the game on Day 1. Your enthusiasm is what keeps us going—THANK YOU!

Today, I'd like to address a recent negative review that highlighted two main issues:
[list]
[*] Lack of localization in languages other than English
[*] The perceived brevity of the gameplay experience.
[/list]
We genuinely appreciate this feedback, and it’s something we are actively working on. We often encourage our players to discuss their concerns directly with us on our Discord server, as it gives us an opportunity to explain our choices and constraints more transparently.

Localizing a game is a substantial endeavor, especially for a small studio like ours. Many might not realize the current challenges in maintaining a game development company. Aside from our own projects, we have to undertake B2B work to sustain our operations. Rest assured, we are committed to implementing a robust localization system, and Italian, along with other languages like German, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, and soon Japanese and Chinese, are on the way. The timing and quality of these localizations are tied to the financial outcomes of this first episode.

Regarding the length of the game, we believe that the essence of a story is not dictated by its duration but by the impact it delivers. Whether in a book, a movie, or a game, the potency of the narrative is what truly matters. Thus, it's misleading to equate shortness with a lack of depth or value.

Thank you for your ongoing support and understanding. Your engagement is crucial for our continued development and success. We're excited about the journey ahead and promise to keep you updated.

For now, that's all.
Greetings from your trusted Cannibal Team.

That's all for now,
Cannibal Team

notes.title: Join Us at The Storyteller's Festival: Experience the Latest in Cannibal Tales!
notes.content:
Hello Cannibal Lover,
Here are the latest news on the development of Cannibal Tales.

We have decided to release each episode as a single Steam product. You can now search for the game on Steam as "[b]Cannibal Tales - Episode 1[/b]". 

What do you think of our new Steam capsule?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/1144caa5f274637b603ceeaa0419cb41c7b87d87.jpg[/img]

Alongside this change, we've made several improvements to the Cannibal Tales demo:

[list]
[*] Dialogue Text Update: We've refined the game's dialogue by correcting errors and adding narrator texts that provide more insights into the story.
[*] New Font: A fresh, more readable font to improve your reading experience.
[*] Audio Fixes: We've ironed out some audio issues for a smoother auditory experience.
[*] Text Skip Improvement: Speed up text composition by pressing a button, making it easier to follow the story at your own pace.
[*] UX Enhancements: Introducing new HUD elements for a more intuitive gameplay experience.
[*] Save Implementations: You can save your progress and return to your adventure anytime.
[*] Volume Control: Adjust the game volume to your liking in the settings menu.
[*] Controller Support: Enjoy the game with your favorite controller for more comfortable play.
[/list]

You can find Cannibal Tales at The Storyteller's Festival, hosted on Steam by [b]Two and a Half Studios[/b].

We hope you enjoy the demo.

Thank you for your ongoing support and interest in Cannibal Tales. Stay tuned for more updates!

That's all for now,
Cannibal Team.

notes.title: Overcoming Steam's 'Adult Content' Tag: A Dev Journey Update
notes.content:
Hello cannibal lover,
Welcome to our first devlog of 2024. 
We wish to start by wishing you all a happy new year and hope that you have had a peaceful and joyous holiday season.

Let's begin by telling you that we are facing an issue with Steam. 
Currently, our game is tagged as 'Frequent Nudity or Sexual Content'. This is due to a misassessment on our part of some of the game's content during the setup of the product page on Steam. 
We are working to remove the adult-only classification. This tag prevents the game from appearing in the searches of users who have disabled the viewing of adult content games, causing us significant issues in terms of discoverability and wishlist additions.

We have attempted to censor the nudity scenes (Helena's breasts) in the public demo, but this was not sufficient for the Steam review team. 
They argue that a significant portion of our game contains sexual content, especially since the first chapter takes place entirely in Helena's bedroom, where she and Paul are engaged in a sexual act at the beginning of the game. 
However, our game does not feature any other sexually explicit content, and the storyline is mainly focused on the theme of cannibalism. Despite our efforts, we have not been able to change Steam's stance.

Furthermore, Steam has notified us that two out of eight screenshots from our game display sexual content. However, we are convinced that these images have been misunderstood.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/fdac6577a4044c81cd02eb07fda91d37246ee02b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/e9fe7d65734207cb891ce71801de619c771e29da.jpg[/img]

Our next steps include removing the screenshots in question and replacing them with others that better represent the theme and atmosphere of the game. Following this, we will submit the full build of the game to Steam for review, to demonstrate that the main focus of the title is on different aspects from sexual content, mainly related to the theme of cannibalism. 
We sincerely hope that this action will persuade the Steam review team to remove the 'Frequent Nudity or Sexual Content' tag from our game.

Regarding the game's development progress, as previously mentioned, all chapters have been completed. We are currently localizing the last four chapters into English. Afterward, we will focus on finalizing the savings systems, options, and credits. Our goal is to finalize these elements by the end of January. 

We will participate in the Steam Next Fest in February with an updated version of the demo. 
The official release of the game is scheduled for the end of February.

That's all for now. We'll talk again next week.

The Cannibal Team.

notes.title: Final 2023 Update: Exciting Progress and Upcoming Release Details
notes.content:
Hello cannibal lover,
Final Devlog of 2023.

We're thrilled to announce that we've completed the implementation of all the game scenes. Currently, we're focusing on refining the settings and saving features. Our goal is to wrap up development by January.

We'll participate in the February Steam Next Fest with an exclusive, updated demo. Additionally, we're excited to share that the game's release is planned for the end of February.

We've also updated the announcement trailer on our Steam page and altered the public demo by censoring sexually explicit content. This ensures the game is discoverable on Steam for users who haven't enabled the adult content options.

You can check out the updated trailer here:
[previewyoutube=kyhxSuZron8;full][/previewyoutube]

The team wishes you happy holidays and extends our deepest thanks for all the support you've given us throughout the past year.

We'll reconnect in 2024.

See you soon,
The Cannibal Team.

notes.title: Horror Awaits: Closed Beta News & Exciting Updates from Cannibal Team!
notes.content:
Hello Cannibal Lover,
We're thrilled to bring you the latest news on Cannibal Tales!

[b]Cannibal Tales will be part of the Steam Scream: The Revenge event.[/b] 
From October 26th to November 2nd, an updated public demo will be available for players.

[b]We are starting a closed beta[/b] from October 31st to November 7th, offering an enhanced experience compared to the public demo which had 2 scenes lasting 10 minutes. The closed beta will grant you access to the first two chapters, encompassing 6 scenes, totaling around 30 minutes of gameplay.
The beta will be in English only and the save function will not be available yet.
Within the application, you'll have the chance to fill out a survey. We genuinely value your insights.

[h3]How to join the beta? [/h3]
By signing up for our mailing list here ---> https://subscribepage.io/KizWnG

[h3]Media Buzz[/h3]
A massive shoutout to the team at Bloody Disgusting. [url=https://bloody-disgusting.com/video-games/3782162/cannibal-tales-closed-beta-planned-for-halloween-new-character-profiles-released/]Ever since they featured us[/url], sign-ups for the closed beta have skyrocketed!

[h3]Invite the Aficionados[/h3]
Do you know any true fans of horror or admirers of Master Ruggero Deodato's work? Please encourage them to join this thrilling journey by signing up for our newsletter.

[h3]Development Status[/h3]
We're in the home stretch! Only the final two scenes, save functionality, options, and localization remain. We're aiming for a Steam release in early February 2024.

[h3]A Glimpse of Art[/h3]
Feast your eyes on this exquisite artwork, showcasing our very own Price hard at work. A taste of what's to come!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/c640e81a477dcefd54929cf1b09aef5930855d2b.png[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates and thank you for being part of this exciting journey.

The Cannibal Team
